title: Ankusa
description: One page for an Ankusa fleet: acknowledgement, delivery, store, intake log, tenants and node health. Each section names the runbooks its alerts link to (docs/runbooks in the repository). Checked in CI: mise run check:monitoring.

panels.title: Requests by outcome
panels.description: Every request the edge answered, by what Ankusa did with it.

panels.title: Ack latency p50 / p99
panels.description: The red line is the 50 ms objective for the 99th percentile.

panels.title: Refused with a 503
panels.description: The alert fires above 1 % for 5 minutes.

panels.title: Store commit and fsync p99
panels.description: The SIGTERM drain budgets 2 s for a commit.

panels.title: Refusals before ingest
panels.description: Requests refused before a hook existed: unknown source, too large, rate limited.

panels.title: Load shed
panels.description: Hooks refused because a batcher partition was full.

panels.title: Delivery latency p99 by sink
panels.description: Received to confirmed, retries included. The red line is the 5 s objective.

panels.title: Attempt duration p99 by sink and result
Age of the oldest due delivery
panels.description: The alert fires above 300 s for 2 minutes.

panels.title: Store, disk and backup (alerts: disk-full, store-write-failed, backup-stale runbooks)
Data volume free
panels.description: The alert fires below 10 % free for 5 minutes.

panels.title: Age of the last successful backup
panels.description: The alert fires above 300 s for 5 minutes.

panels.title: Intake log, wal.type: dual (alert: intake-down runbook)
Breaker state
panels.description: 1 = closed; 0 = open or probing: every hook is a 503 intake_unavailable.

panels.title: Tenants refused with 429 tenant_overload
panels.description: Top 10. Empty at metrics.detail: none, which carries no tenant label.

panels.title: Tenants with the most first attempts waiting
panels.description: Top 10 of the 100 tenants each node reports.

panels.title: Tenants holding the most in-flight deliveries
Failure-domain outages
panels.description: A dispatch, storage, lifecycle, metrics or listener subtree out of restart budget.

panels.title: Series on /metrics per node
panels.description: The budget is 10 000 series per node, independent of tenants.
